tests: New and v25 saves receive 5,000 coins while lives and recorded prizes are preserved
Eight repeated requests commit one 100-coin debit and one life prize, including a reload mid-spin
Insufficient coins cannot draw symbols, create a spin or change lives
A rewarded video credits 1,000 coins only after earned=true and cannot be credited twice
Coin refill is bounded at 5,000 and handles invalid or backward timestamps
Three Crystal bonus spins work with zero coins and never spend a life or a coin
Forge relaunch costs 100 coins once and preserves the selected reels
AUTO stops after the last affordable spin without a negative balance or a third transaction
Navigation and chest collection cannot debit coins
Malformed wallet numbers restore finite non-negative balances and bounded counters
scope: Production wallet and spin transactions; deterministic DOM/clock and rewarded bridge adapters.
